articles.title: Bitwise model puts bitcoin fair value at $224,000 as sovereign-default hedge
articles.snippet: The figure is from a theoretical model proposed by Greg Foss in 2021 that treats bitcoin as a credit default swap on G20 sovereign bonds.

articles.title: Trezor says your crypto is safe after Ledger audit exposes a hardware flaw
articles.snippet: The flaw affects only one of the wallet's multiple security layers and would require physical access, specialized equipment and advanced expertise to exploit.

articles.title: Trezor says Safe 7 chip flaw found by Ledger does not put funds at risk
articles.snippet: Trezor and Tropic Square disclosed a TROPIC01 chip vulnerability found during a Ledger Donjon audit, saying the Safe 7 wallet and user funds remain secure.

articles.title: Trezor Reveals Hardware Wallet Vulnerability, But Funds 'Safe'
articles.snippet: The vulnerability in Trezor's TROPIC01 Secure Element chip was uncovered by an audit carried out by the Ledger Donjon team.
